items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: my mother sent me to, a school. Professor Miller H. Nelson. I went to school... That's where I went to school.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Ramport in St. Louis.

Then I was at the, moved from there to the Ramp to Bermall. To what? Bermall and Robinson. Then from there, across Claiborne, school is called, Bermall School is called Wickers High. Wickers? Wicker. The professor, the principal was, uh, come over, Mr. Wicker. And after he died, he didn't even know school at the end. Uh, I didn't learn anything in the public school. I went to, or my mother sent me to, a school. Professor Miller H. Nelson. I went to school, I couldn't read the program. I couldn't read the program.…
He was? He had to be a little house. How many students were there at school? About 25.
